subsection.title: Canceling common factors
subsection.p: For x\neq1, we may cancel the common factor x-1:
The condition x\neq1 stays. The original expression was not defined at x=1. Canceling a factor simplifies nearby values, but it does not restore the missing input.

note.title: Cancel factors, not terms
note.p: The numerator x^2-1 is a difference, not a product.
